name: Silver-led precious-metals flight divergence — short crypto beta when silver surges into a risk-off while crypto stalls
rationale: MECHANISM: a distinct precious-metals expression of the Great-Decoupling fade — silver_xag, being higher-beta than gold, often leads or amplifies a genuine precious-metals flight-to-safety rotation. When silver surges hard WHILE crypto momentum stalls (negative ret_Nd), capital is rotating into the metals safe-haven complex and away from speculative crypto beta, so crypto underperforms. Using silver rather than gold tests whether the metals-flight signal is cleaner in the higher-beta metal (a real rotation shows up first and biggest in silver). Short crypto beta into the divergence. DISCONFIRMER: silver is ALSO an industrial metal, so a silver surge can be a growth/inflation-reflation signal (risk-ON), which would make a crypto short backwards — even more ambiguous than gold. Kill unless OOS shows the silver surge fires during genuine risk-off (cross-check: crypto momentum negative filters the reflation case), and unless the short's net-of-funding/borrow edge clears carry. If silver adds nothing over the gold variant (hh-macro-21), keep only gold.
catalyst: silver-led precious-metals flight with crypto momentum stalling
